tools.name: plan
tools.description: The next task of a spec change, with only what is needed to start it: its files, endpoints, tables, tests and the command to run them. Call this instead of reading tasks.md.

task.description: task id (T3); omit for the next unfinished one

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask a question about this repo in plain language. A cheap model answers from the graph in a few lines and names the facts it used. Use this instead of chaining search/context/impact yourself.

question.description: e.g. "what does the warehouse change touch?"

files.description: optional repo-relative paths to ground the answer

tools.name: status
tools.description: Graph health: node counts, endpoints no page calls, endpoints no test covers, pages without e2e.
